scene.line: Diva Wings loved shopping.
All she would do all day was shop, shop and more shopping!
One day as she was flying to Fawn's Hideout,
she saw a Pixie Posting for the Pixie Hollow campout.
There is no way I'm going.
The new collections come out this week...
I will be the first to buy them!
She flew on totally ignoring the posting.
When she got to Fawn's,
she started talking about the new collections.
Fawn was tired of hearing about Diva and her clothes.
Fawn thought of a great idea...
to help Diva Wings get over her shopping obsession.
I will trick her into coming to the campout
and remembering how great nature is!
So Fawn told Diva Wings that she found a really great store.
And it just happened to be on the way to the campout!
Diva Wings was so happy she would be first to see the store.
She left with Fawn and realized that there was no store!
Hey, you tricked me!
I just wanted you to see how beautiful it is
and how you should really forget about shopping.
Wow, I never realized I was so caught up in shopping
and not even helping with the season changes or anything.
Thank you Fawn for showing me nature and animals!
I promise I'll start helping and not shop for a long time!
The whole night Diva Wings forgot about the new collections
and played with the animals.
At night she sang songs and helped put baby animals to bed.
I'm so grateful for this campout,
I can't wait till next year's!
